sandbachFocus: Sandbach United were not in league action this weekend, instead competing in the FA Vase where they suffered a narrow defeat to Ashby Ivanhoe. The Bach mounted a better second-half performance but ultimately couldn't find the breakthrough, losing in what manager JKD described as a disappointing cup exit after recent league inconsistency.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals maintained their excellent form with a 1-0 victory at Dawley Town courtesy of Liam Kirton's 66th-minute goal, keeping them top of the table. AFC Bridgnorth bounced back impressively from their midweek draw, thrashing Crewe 4-1 at home with goals from Dubz, Suar, and a brace from Zazi to stay second. Shawbury United claimed all three points in an entertaining 3-2 home win over Widnes Town with Ethan Pickford scoring twice. Bilston Town dominated their trip to Brereton Social, winning 3-0 with goals from Carter, Guest, and Crump. In cup action, several clubs exited the FA Vase: Eccleshall impressed with a 4-0 demolition of Allscott Heath, Telford Town won a penalty shootout against Darlaston Town despite a 1-1 draw, and Foley Meir advanced on penalties after a 0-0 stalemate with Redditch Borough. Notable struggles saw Stafford Town lose 3-0 to Abbey Hulton, Market Drayton Town exit to Studley (3-1), and both Cheadle Heath Nomads and Wednesfield Community bowing out of the Vase.
